Both different 500-row datasets report five zero row checksums. Compression checksums do not implement this feature; the unchanged determinism sibling remains enabled.

entries.test: Gluten - orc.force.positional.evolution maps Hive ORC columns by position
entries.reason: Observed on Spark 4.2 with Bolt c3548fe: Bolt Hive ORC scan omits the per-scan Spark orc.force.positional.evolution mapping. Native uses its backend-global orcUseColumnNames=true and reads renamed fields by name, returning [null,null] instead of [1,2]. The native reader has positional support; this is a bridge configuration gap. Original SQL, configuration and assertions are retained.
